description: Character turnaround model sheet of Lumi on a plain soft cream background: four views side by side, front, three-quarter, side and back, same size, same pose standing low, evenly lit.

Expression sheet of Lumi on a plain soft cream background: a neat grid of six head-and-shoulders portraits, from left to right and top to bottom: sleepy, asleep, yawning, happy, curious, cosy hugging Twinkle.
Character design sheet of Pip on a plain soft cream background: front view and three-quarter view, plus a small view holding his candle, in the same soft felt style as Lumi.
Character design sheet of Mo on a plain soft cream background: front view, three-quarter view, and curled up asleep in a ball with his tail around him, in the same soft felt style as Lumi.

Wide establishing shot of the empty living room, eye level, calm symmetric composition with the round window in the upper middle and the fireplace on the left, plenty of soft dark areas, no characters.

Welcome shot: the old hollow tree in the Dreamnest valley at night, a warm glowing round window in the trunk, soft rain, the smiling full moon Momo above, a tiny silhouette of Lumi in the window. Wide, calm, room for a slow dolly-in.
Wide interior: Lumi sits in the rocking chair with a knitted blanket, hugging Twinkle, the fire crackling beside her, rain on the window.
Pip arrives at the round wooden door carrying his small candle, his long scarf trailing behind him; Lumi looks up happily from the rocking chair.
Lumi and Pip sit at the little round table, soft steam curling up from the teapot and two small cups, warm firelight on their faces.
Close-medium shot: Mo curls up into a round ball on a knitted rug in front of the fireplace, tail wrapped around him, eyes closing.
Close shot of the round window: soft rain drops on the glass, outside the smiling full moon Momo glows gently over the valley, a hint of warm firelight reflected in the glass.
Medium close-up: Lumi gives a small sleepy yawn while hugging Twinkle, the star softly glowing, firelight on her cheek.
Lumi, Pip and Mo snuggle together on the big knitted rug under one soft blanket, the star night light switched on, the fire lower and warmer.
Close-up: Lumi falls asleep, eyes closed, Twinkle glowing softly in her arms, the room darker and warmer, very peaceful.

Wide, very calm and dark-warm: everyone asleep on the rug, the fire glowing low, rain on the window, Momo outside. Base frame for the long sleep loop: very little contrast, nothing that needs to move fast.
